moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: England, Wales, and Northern Ireland celebrate the Summer Bank Holiday on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend and a major travel period.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is officially here for England, Wales & NI. Expect busy roads and rail, so plan your journeys.

angles.name: Last Summer Hurrah
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of summer! What are your plans for the long weekend? Making the most of it before autumn officially arrives?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals 2026
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festivals kick off tomorrow, running from August 27-30 with major headliners including Florence + The Machine, Chase & Status, Fontaines D.C., Dave, Raye, Skepta, Charli XCX, Gunna, and KNEECAP.

angles.name: Festival Kicks Off
angles.copy: It's almost time! Reading & Leeds Festivals officially begin tomorrow. Who are you buzzing to see on the main stage this weekend?

angles.name: Leeds Festival Local
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is back at Bramham Park from tomorrow! Get ready for a massive weekend of music. Who's heading down?

moments.title: All Points East Final Weekend
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival continues its run at Victoria Park, with headline shows this weekend from Tyler, The Creator, Twenty One Pilots, and more, concluding on Sunday, August 30.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is still bringing the heat to Victoria Park this weekend! Who's catching Tyler, The Creator or Twenty One Pilots before it wraps up?

angles.name: Weekend Headliners
angles.copy: Another huge festival weekend in London! All Points East features Tyler, The Creator and Twenty One Pilots closing out the event.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues with Matchweek 2 fixtures from Friday, August 28 to Sunday, August 30, including Crystal Palace v Manchester City, Spurs v Newcastle, and Chelsea v Brighton.

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 2 kicks off Friday night as Crystal Palace host Manchester City! Who's getting the win?

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Big weekend of Premier League action ahead! Liverpool, Spurs, Chelsea, and more are all in action for Matchweek 2. Which game are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on Wednesday, September 2, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back
angles.copy: Get your ovens ready! The Great British Bake Off returns next Wednesday, September 2nd, on Channel 4. And yes, Nigella Lawson is in the tent!

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent as a new judge when the show returns next week. What do you think of the new line-up?

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the iconic frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28. She is also headlining Reading & Leeds Festivals this weekend.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: An icon turns 40! Happy Birthday to Florence Welch from Florence + The Machine this Friday. Catch her headlining Reading & Leeds too!

angles.name: Birthday & Festival
angles.copy: Florence Welch celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, and she's spending it headlining two of the UK's biggest festivals! What a legend.

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison will celebrate his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31.

angles.name: Happy 81st Van
angles.copy: The incomparable Van Morrison turns 81 this Monday! What's your favourite 'Van the Man' track?

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating a true music legend! Van Morrison hits 81 on Monday, still bringing that timeless blues and soul.

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning Cuban-American singer Gloria Estefan, known for hits like 'Conga' and 'Rhythm of the Night', celebrates her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gloria
angles.copy: Get on your feet and celebrate! Happy 69th Birthday to the incredible Gloria Estefan this Tuesday.

angles.name: Queen of Latin Pop
angles.copy: Turning 69 on Tuesday, it's the Queen of Latin Pop, Gloria Estefan! What's your favourite Miami Sound Machine classic?

moments.title: Al Jardine turns 84
moments.blurb: Founding member and guitarist of The Beach Boys, Al Jardine, will celebrate his 84th birthday on Thursday, September 3.

angles.name: Good Vibrations Birthday
angles.copy: Sending good vibrations for Al Jardine's 84th birthday this Thursday! The Beach Boys legend is still rocking.

angles.name: Beach Boys Icon
angles.copy: Happy 84th Birthday to The Beach Boys' Al Jardine on Thursday! What's your favourite song featuring his iconic vocals?

moments.title: Steve Jones turns 71
moments.blurb: Sex Pistols guitarist Steve Jones, a foundational figure in punk rock, celebrates his 71st birthday on Thursday, September 3.

angles.name: Punk Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to punk rock pioneer Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols this Thursday! Still a 'Pretty Vacant' legend.

angles.name: Sex Pistols Guitarist
angles.copy: Celebrating Steve Jones, the guitarist who helped define punk, on his 71st birthday this Thursday!

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, will celebrate her 45th birthday on Friday, September 4.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé turns 45 this Friday. What's your ultimate Beyoncé power anthem?

angles.name: Happy 45th Beyoncé
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Beyoncé on Friday! From Destiny's Child to global icon, her reign continues.

moments.title: Mark Ronson turns 51
moments.blurb: Grammy and Oscar-winning DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson, known for hits like 'Uptown Funk' and his work with Amy Winehouse, celebrates his 51st birthday on Friday, September 4.

angles.name: Producer's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the legendary producer Mark Ronson this Friday! What's your favourite track he's produced?

angles.name: Uptown Funk Birthday
angles.copy: Turning 51 on Friday, it's the 'Uptown Funk' maestro, Mark Ronson! Let's celebrate his incredible career.
